description: This file defines the API endpoints for managing attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating individual attendance records, handling timezone conversions, validation, and overlap checks. The class 'AttendanceRecordAPI' extends a base 'Endpoint' class and implements 'ResourceEndpoint', using traits for common functionalities. It leverages OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving and updating attendance records, including handling time zones, overlap validation, and permissions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendance record by ID, verifying user permissions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing attendance record with new punch-in and punch-out data after validation and overlap checks.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheActions
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to perform actions on the provided attendance record based on roles and ownership.

methods.name: setAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Processes request data and updates the attendance record, including overlap validation and timezone handling.

methods.name: getRequestBodyParams
methods.description: Retrieves punch data parameters from the request body.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from punch date and time strings, adjusted for timezone offset.

methods.name: isAllowedToEditTimezone
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to edit timezone-related fields based on their values.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' API operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' API operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises an exception if called.
